eng.title: Machine Vision Engineer
eng.eyebrow: Machine Vision · Surface Defect Inspection · Inline Deployment
eng.role: Three years in industrial surface defect inspection, from illumination design to production rollout. I split "we cannot detect it" into imaging, labelling and modelling, then close each one until the chain runs inside the line cycle time.

experience.title: Senior Machine Vision Engineer
bullets: Own inline inspection for electrode coating and welding: 0.15 mm smallest detectable defect, 0.3% miss rate, 60 m/min line speed.
Raised defect-to-background contrast from 4 to 21 grey levels through camera and illumination selection.

experience.title: Machine Vision Engineer
bullets: Shipped an inline wafer defect system covering 8 defect classes at 98.6% accuracy, cutting false calls from 3.1% to 0.8%.
Quantised with TensorRT to 18 ms per image on Jetson AGX Orin, replacing a manual re-inspection station.

skills: Imaging
Bright-field, dark-field and coaxial illumination; line-scan and area camera calibration; sub-pixel edge extraction.
Modelling
Anomaly detection (PatchCore family), few-shot classification, segmentation; long-tail handling; synthetic defects.
Deployment
PyTorch → ONNX → TensorRT, Jetson edge deployment, C++ inference wrapping, cycle-time alignment.

sci.title: Data Analyst
sci.role: Three years in analytics, most of it spent on one question: did this number go up because of the strategy, or because the market moved. The tools are experiment design and causal inference; in practice that means metric definitions, traffic validation and incremental evaluation.

experience.title: Senior Data Analyst
bullets: Evaluated campaign and ranking-slot effects with difference-in-differences, isolating a 3.2% true lift and retiring two negative placements for about 2.4M CNY in quarterly savings.
Consolidated 47 competing metric definitions into 12 core metrics plus a data dictionary, cutting ad-hoc data requests by 60%.

experience.title: Data Analyst
bullets: Built operating dashboards for six consumer clients and three reusable analysis templates, shortening delivery from three weeks to nine days.
Ran a quasi-experiment on store siting with propensity-score matching; the result informed site review for 14 new stores.

skills: Data
SQL (window functions, complex joins), Python (pandas, numpy), R; cleaning tens of millions of rows.
Experiments
A/B design, power calculation, traffic validation; DID, PSM and regression discontinuity, with their assumptions.
Communication
Tableau and Power BI dashboards; written reports that end in a decision, not a chart dump.

arts.title: Content Operations
arts.eyebrow: Content Operations · Brand Copy · Building Accounts from Zero
arts.role: Three years in content operations, from editorial calendars to post-campaign reviews. I try to turn products nobody cares about into stories people finish, and when a topic fails I say so in the review instead of blaming the headline.
summary_facts: Consumer brand content and account growth

experience.title: Content Lead
bullets: Ran the brand's WeChat account and Xiaohongshu in parallel: 86 long-form posts in a year, 120k followers from zero, 8.4% open rate against a 2.1% category average, three posts past 100k reads.
Grew Xiaohongshu from zero to 32k followers across 210 notes, with roughly 180 inbound messages a month, about a third moving into the sales channel.

experience.title: Content Planner
bullets: Wrote scripts for three lifestyle accounts; the best-performing video reached 4.8M views and added 76k followers.
Standardised the script template and shot list, cutting onboarding from two weeks to four days.

skills: Editorial
Topic sourcing from audience and usage scenarios, column planning, balancing trending and evergreen content.
Writing
Long-form, product copy and video scripts; switching register between brand, creator and ordinary-user voice.
Review
Attributing open rate, completion and conversion; changing a topic when the data says so.

soc.title: User Researcher
soc.eyebrow: User Research · Qualitative Interviews · Policy Evaluation
soc.role: Three years in research, interviewing first and quantifying second. I have done zero-to-one product research and third-party evaluation of public services; the method is the same in both. Get people to say something true, then turn it into a decision.

experience.title: User Researcher
bullets: Led research across consumer and public-service lines: 280+ in-depth interviews and a 12,000-response survey design.
Standardised the qualitative coding process with dual coding and disagreement review, cutting the report cycle from six weeks to four.

experience.title: Research Assistant
bullets: Contributed to a municipal elderly-care evaluation: 214 interviews and 3,600 valid questionnaires; the findings were adopted into next year's budget adjustment.
Compared policy documents across five cities on subsidy rules, supporting a pilot-eligibility application.

skills: Qualitative
In-depth interviews, focus groups, observation; sampling and saturation; non-leading question design.
Quantitative
Questionnaire design and validity checks, sampling and weighting; SPSS and Stata; NVivo coding.
Reporting
Turning 80,000 words of field notes into 20 pages of conclusions, and stating uncertainty out loud.
